messages.content: 一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.reasoning: We need to calculate entropy change for 1 kg ice heated from 0°C to 100°C at 1 atm. But ice at 0°C melts at 0°C, then water from 0°C to 100°C. So we need latent heat of fusion at 0°C: ΔH_fusion = 334 kJ/kg. Latent heat of vaporization at 100°C: ΔH_vaporization = 2257 kJ/kg. But the question says heating to 100°C, not boiling. So final state is liquid water at 100°C. So we only consider melting and heating water. Entropy change: ΔS = ∫ dQ_rev/T. For phase change at constant T: ΔS = ΔH/T. For heating water from 0°C to 100°C: ΔS = ∫ C_p dT / T. Use average Cp of water ~ 4184 J/(kg·K). So integral from 273.15 K to 373.15 K: ∫ Cp dT / T = Cp ln(T2/T1). So ΔS_water = Cp ln(373.15/273.15). Cp=4184 J/(kg·K). Ln ratio: ln(373.15/273.15)=ln(1.366)=0.312. So ΔS_water ≈ 4184*0.312=1305 J/K. For melting: ΔS_melt = ΔH_fusion / T_melt. ΔH_fusion=334000 J/kg. T=273.15 K. So ΔS_melt=334000/273.15=1222 J/K. Total ΔS=1222+1305=2527 J/K. So answer: 2527 J/K. Provide explanation.
